meta.title: Responses — hide fields
gaps: Start from and verify an RFQ with two bids priced at A 100 and B 90; the prepared state has one bid and cannot create or add another bid.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Start from and verify an RFQ with two bids priced at A 100 and B 90; the prepared state has one bid and cannot create or add another bid.

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ Responses screen as the buyer; this is the required first step for the prepared state.
Open the Responses grid field-visibility controls.
Select GST in the field-visibility menu to hide that column.
Close the field-visibility menu so the grid can be checked without the menu option masking the result.
Assert that GST no longer appears in the Responses grid.
